decisions.bounded_finding: Montana’s official SNAP manual index identifies the captured current work-registration and ABAWD section set, while SNAP 700 identifies itself as the work-registration authority and supersedes the May 4, 2023 version. This finding is limited to the captured manual index and section, not the completeness of every Montana SNAP rule.

Montana SNAP 700 states an effective date of June 1, 2025 for the captured work-registration overview, and SNAP 802-1 states an effective date of November 1, 2025 for the captured geographic-waiver rule. These dates are section-specific and do not establish one universal effective date for the full program.

Montana SNAP 802-1 states that, as of November 1, 2025, no areas within Montana had approved ABAWD geographic waivers, and the section is effective November 1, 2025. This is a bounded official no-waiver state at that effective date, not a claim of permanent or person-level absence.
